title: 第一卷 第23章 天光道法，天光斩妖诀！
content_zh:
“好。”

    陆承锋缓缓站起身，俯首凝视着眼前四个少年人，眼中似映着四簇火种！

    仿佛看到它们日后将在这人间之地，燃起燎原烈火，照亮前路！【表情】

    他将手中的长剑缓缓递出，神色肃穆而郑重，声音铿锵浑厚，震彻山洞。【表情】

    “且，执剑！”【表情】

    话音落下，陈渊等人只觉心魂被狠狠震荡！

    那声音如洪钟大吕，撞得他们热血翻涌，神色愈发激昂。【表情】

    四人齐齐伸出双手，共同接过了陆承锋手中的长剑。

    那是一把青铜色的长剑，配套的剑鞘亦是青铜所铸，上面刻着奇异的云纹，流转着淡淡的古朴气息。【表情】

    四人各自扶住剑的一处，神色皆显肃穆，连呼吸都放轻了几分。【表情】

    陆承锋望着他们四人，嘴角微微上扬，眼底掠过一丝欣慰——就像是看到自己毕生坚守的理念，终于有了传承之人，心中积压的郁气也消散了大半，痛快不已。【表情】

    “就此，便是死了，也无憾了。”

    陆承锋在心中默念，嘴角猛地溢出一缕猩红的鲜血。【表情】

    他立刻转过身去，生怕眼前这四个小家伙看到自己的模样，徒增担忧。【表情】

    蓦地，他瞥见洞外的大黑马并未逃走，反而正带着讨好之意，走过来舔着他脚边的野草。

    陆承锋眸光微微一敛，不禁摸了摸大黑马的脑袋，沉声道：“接下来，我教你们四个天光道法，以及，天光斩妖诀。”【表情】

    他说着，依旧没有回头，语气郑重：“你们四个，且仔细听好。”【表情】

    陈渊满脸错愕，心里直犯嘀咕：

    我靠，原来陆大叔还藏了一手！

    这个老登！【表情】

    他心中难免有些郁闷——原本以为自己所学的缚龙搏杀术，和玄黄正气诀，已是陆承锋的压箱底绝学！

    万万没想到，还有更厉害的功法！【表情】

    “天光道法？天光斩妖诀？”

    陈昭宁眼中燃起炽烈的光芒，激动地开口，“难道是传说中执剑会里，那位紫府真人所创立的无上功法和剑技？专门克制魔物妖邪的那种？”【表情】

    陆承锋脚步一顿，没有回头，沉默了半晌，声音又变得沙哑起来：“不愧是陈家大小姐，这般隐秘之事，你也知晓。”【表情】

    陈昭宁愈发激动，美眸中泛着异彩：“那是自然！

    当初那位紫府真人，可是惊才绝艳的人物，震慑大相帝国，无人能及！”

    “可大相帝国太过可恶，不知道派了多少真君出马，一心要抹杀我们人族的这位妖孽，断我人族希望！”

    说到这里，陈昭宁攥紧了拳头，咬牙切齿，眼中满是愤恨。【表情】

    “.............”

    陆承锋陷入了长久的沉默，一股难以言喻的无奈与伤感，在他周身弥漫开来，让山洞里的气氛瞬间变得压抑，几人都下意识地屏住了呼吸。【表情】
content_en:
"Okay."

Lu Chengfeng stood up slowly, lowered his head and stared at the four young people in front of him, his eyes seemed to be reflecting four clusters of fire!

It seems as if I can see them setting off a prairie fire in this human world in the future, lighting up the road ahead!【expression】

He slowly handed out the long sword in his hand, his expression solemn and solemn, and his voice was sonorous and resonant, which shook the cave.【expression】

"And, hold the sword!" [expression]

As soon as the words fell, Chen Yuan and others felt their hearts and souls being severely shaken!

The sound was like a bell, making their blood boil and their expressions becoming more and more excited.【expression】

The four of them stretched out their hands and jointly took the long sword from Lu Chengfeng's hand.

It was a bronze long sword, and the matching scabbard was also made of bronze. It was engraved with strange cloud patterns and exuded a faint aura of simplicity.【expression】

The four of them each held a part of their sword, their expressions were solemn, and they even breathed a little lighter.【expression】

Lu Chengfeng looked at the four of them, the corner of his mouth raised slightly, and a trace of relief flashed in his eyes - as if he saw that the concept he had adhered to all his life finally had someone to inherit it, and most of the depression in his heart had dissipated, and he was very happy.【expression】

"With this, even if I die, I will have no regrets."

Lu Chengfeng thought silently in his heart, and a wisp of scarlet blood suddenly spilled out of the corner of his mouth.【expression】

He immediately turned around, fearing that the four little guys in front of him would see his appearance and become worried.【expression】

Suddenly, he saw that the big black horse outside the cave did not run away, but came over to lick the weeds at his feet with the intention of trying to please him.

Lu Chengfeng's eyes narrowed slightly, he couldn't help but touch the big black horse's head, and said solemnly: "Next, I will teach you four Tianguang Taoist techniques, as well as the Tianguang Demon Slaying Technique." [Expression]

He said, still not looking back, with a solemn tone: "You four, please listen carefully." [Expression]

Chen Yuan's face was full of astonishment, and he muttered in his heart:

Damn it, it turns out that Uncle Lu has something up his sleeve!

This Lao Deng!【expression】

He was inevitably a little depressed - he originally thought that the dragon-binding fighting technique and the Xuanhuang Zhengqi Jue he had learned were already Lu Chengfeng's most unique skills!

I never expected that there would be even more powerful techniques!【expression】

"Tianguang Taoism? Tianguang Demon Slaying Technique?"

Chen Zhaoning's eyes ignited with blazing light, and he spoke excitedly, "Is it the supreme martial arts and sword skills created by the legendary Master Zifu in the Sword Holding Association? The kind that specifically restrains monsters and evil spirits?" [Expression]

Lu Chengfeng paused and did not look back. He was silent for a long time, and his voice became hoarse again: "As expected of the eldest lady of the Chen family, you also know such secret things." [Expression]

Chen Zhaoning became more and more excited, his beautiful eyes glowing: "That's natural!

That real person from the Zi Mansion back then was a man of astonishing talent and beauty who shocked the Prime Minister's Empire like no one else!"

"But the Great Prime Minister's Empire is too hateful. I don't know how many true monarchs have been sent out to destroy this monster of our human race and destroy the hope of our human race!"

Having said this, Chen Zhaoning clenched his fists, gritted his teeth, and his eyes were full of resentment.【expression】

"............"

Lu Chengfeng fell into a long silence. An indescribable helplessness and sadness spread around him, making the atmosphere in the cave instantly become depressing. Several people subconsciously held their breath.【expression】
